title: Man of La Mancha
writer: Dale Wasserman, Miguel de Cervantes y Saavedra
actors: Peter O'Toole, Sophia Loren, James Coco
plot: The funny story of mad but kind and chivalrous elderly nobleman Don Quixote who, aided by his squire Sancho Panza, fights windmills that are seen as dragons to save prostitute Dulcinea who is seen as a noblewoman.
awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 2 wins & 3 nominations total
